entries.text:
# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

Nau ku fa mamana oe, a God nau, na o, haungi nau, uriu kua haitamanu, ma kua foa hataumu. Nau ku mamana li kada na, kua atai makeso la nau gi, i fafo na rigita la oe, na siofa la nau i fafo na initoga oe, e langi lau ta God, teoei oe na, na fufa kada ana ta'a la, ma a toto firi.
